questions: Should the function follow redirects automatically (e.g., HTTP 301/302) before extracting links, or should it extract links from the initial response?
Should the function handle JavaScript-generated links (e.g., those added after page load) or only static HTML?
Should duplicate links be removed, or should all occurrences be included in the list?
Should the function extract links from <frame> and <iframe> tags as mentioned, and if so, how should it handle nested frames recursively?
Should the function handle malformed HTML (e.g., tags not properly closed) gracefully, and if so, what parser options should be used?
Should the function include links from other tags with href attributes (e.g., <link>, <area>) or only from <a> tags?
Should the function handle authentication or cookies if required to access the page?
Should the function validate or normalize URLs (e.g., remove fragments, handle query parameters) before returning them?
